import html # Predefined HTML template for blog posts. # The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` will be replaced with the # escaped title and body content. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Formats a blog post for safe display on a webpage. The function escapes all HTML special characters in the title and body to prevent XSS attacks, then inserts them into a predefined HTML template. Parameters: post_title (str): The headline or title of the blog post. post_body (str): The full text content of the blog post. Returns: str: A fully formatted, HTML-escaped blog post ready for rendering. """ # Escape the title and body to neutralize any embedded markup or scripts. safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # The body may contain line breaks; convert them to
tags for HTML display. safe_body = safe_body.replace('\n', '
\n') # Insert the escaped content into the template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
